title: Professional Certificate Course in Trade Distortion and the Marketing Barriers
description: It is designed to enable students to identify and analyze the economic, political, and social factors that create these barriers and their impact on international trade.
longDescription: Understand the impact of tariffs and non-tariff barriers on international trade. Identify different modes of transportation and their advantages and disadvantages for businesses. Analyze the benefits and drawbacks of protectionist policies in international trade. Evaluate the importance of cargo or transportation insurance in managing risks associated with international trade. Explain the roles and responsibilities of freight forwarders and customs brokers in international trade. Explore the foreign exchange market and exchange rate systems to better understand their impact on international trade. The aim of the course on Trade Distortion and Marketing Barriers is to provide students with an in-depth understanding of the impact of trade distortions and marketing barriers on international trade. Through the course, students will learn about the various types of trade barriers and the factors that contribute to their emergence. They will also explore the effects of these barriers on businesses and consumers, and strategies for overcoming them to facilitate international trade. After the successful completion of the course, you will be able to learn about the following.
courseDetails: The course on Trade Distortion and Marketing Barriers provides a comprehensive overview of the challenges faced by businesses operating in an increasingly globalized marketplace. Students will learn about the various forms of trade barriers, including tariffs and non-tariff barriers, and how they can impact international trade. The course also covers the different modes of transportation, cargo insurance, freight forwarding, and customs brokerage, as well as the role of the foreign exchange market in international trade.
